nodes.label: Claim 1
nodes.text: Metformin Hydrochloride Tablet is indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus.

nodes.label: Claim 2
nodes.text: Metformin Hydrochloride Tablets should not be used in patients with an estimated glomerular filtration rate below 30 mL/min/1.73 m².

nodes.label: Claim 3
nodes.text: Metformin is prescribed worldwide to over 120 million individuals with type-2 diabetes.

nodes.label: Claim 4
nodes.text: Metformin is a widely used drug for the treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus with a known ability to lower blood glucose levels.

nodes.label: Claim 5
nodes.text: Metformin hydrochloride can cause a rare but serious side effect called lactic acidosis, which can be fatal.

nodes.label: Claim 6
nodes.text: Lactic acidosis is a medical emergency that must be treated in a hospital.

nodes.label: Claim 7
nodes.text: People whose kidneys are not working properly should not take metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets.

nodes.label: Claim 8
nodes.text: Metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets are used with diet and exercise to help control high blood sugar in adults and children 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes.

nodes.label: Claim 9
nodes.text: Metformin hydrochloride extended-release tablets are not for people with type 1 diabetes.

nodes.label: Claim 10
nodes.text: Postmarketing cases of metformin-associated lactic acidosis have resulted in death, hypothermia, hypotension, and resistant bradyarrhythmias.

nodes.label: Claim 11
nodes.text: Risk factors for metformin-associated lactic acidosis include renal impairment, concomitant use of certain drugs, age over 65 years, radiological studies with contrast, surgery, hypoxic states, excessive alcohol intake, and hepatic impairment.

nodes.label: Claim 12
nodes.text: Tamoxifen is the only drug approved for reduction of breast cancer risk in premenopausal women.

nodes.label: Claim 13
nodes.text: Metformin's licensed uses include treatment of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).

nodes.label: Claim 14
nodes.text: Glucocorticoids have powerful anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects.

nodes.label: Claim 15
nodes.text: Metformin Hydrochloride Tablets may need to be discontinued at the time of, or prior to, iodinated contrast imaging procedures.

nodes.label: Claim 16
nodes.text: Metformin lowers circulating insulin.

nodes.label: Claim 17
nodes.text: Chronic use of glucocorticoids can cause hyperglycemia, type 2 diabetes mellitus, hepatic steatosis, obesity, and other complications due to their metabolic actions.

nodes.label: Claim 18
nodes.text: Metformin inhibits complex I of the mitochondrial electron transport chain, crucial gluconeogenic enzymes, and fatty acid synthesis, leading to a significant improvement in glucose tolerance and maintenance of insulin sensitivity during glucocorticoid treatment.

nodes.label: Claim 19
nodes.text: Metformin is safe during pregnancy.

nodes.label: Claim 20
nodes.text: Three small randomized control trials have demonstrated that metformin can limit changes in glucose metabolism during treatment with prednisone.
